## User story
As a **[role]**, I need **[capability]**, so that **[business benefit]**.

## Acceptance criteria (Gherkin)
**Given** [initial state]  
**When** [action occurs]  
**Then** [expected outcome].

## Planning
- Backlog: Product Backlog / Sprint Backlog
- Sprint: Sprint 1 – Customer Service Core Features
- Story points: [1, 2, 3, 5, 8]
- Type: feature / bug / technical debt

## Definition of done
- [ ] Acceptance criteria satisfied
- [ ] Reviewed or tested
- [ ] Documentation updated
